competition.name: ventilator-pressure-prediction
competition.description: Simulate a ventilator connected to a sedated patient's lung. Predict the airway pressure in the respiratory circuit during each breath given time series of control inputs (R, C, u_in, u_out). Only the inspiratory phase (u_out == 0) is scored.
competition.evaluation_metric: mean absolute error (MAE), computed only on inspiratory-phase rows (u_out == 0)
competition.notes: MLE-bench medium-complexity split (prepared data from mle-bench, graded offline against private split). Time-series grouped by breath_id, 80 timesteps per breath.

metric.name: mean absolute error (MAE), computed only on inspiratory-phase rows (u_out == 0)

grading.note: offline grade record(s) — graded against a held-out split, not a live leaderboard; see competition config notes for grading context

sections.ventilator-pressure-prediction — STATUS:
**Final CV (honest 5-fold OOF, masked MAE on u_out==0): 0.19222 snapped (raw 0.19361).**
**Model: BiLSTM-4x256 seq2seq, 53 per-timestep features, bf16 AMP, 260-epoch OneCycle, 5-fold KFold on breaths; submission = median across 5 fold models + snap-to-pressure-grid.**
**vs run1 (0.24004 OOF single fold, mlebench grade 0.2315): −0.048 CV; medal threshold 0.1638 likely still out of reach.**
sections.Pipeline:
- Features: run1's validated 41 + 12 new (R×C cross one-hot 9, u_in cummax, cummean, reverse-cumsum). All per-timestep, (n_breaths, 80, 53), z-normalized.
- Model: Linear→LayerNorm→SiLU input proj, 4-layer bidirectional LSTM h=256, 2-layer head. Masked L1 loss (u_out==0 only). AdamW lr 2e-3, OneCycle 260 epochs, batch 1024, grad clip 5.
- Speed: bf16 autocast + GPU-resident tensors + cudnn.benchmark on GB10 → ~7 s/epoch vs run1's 46.8 s (≈6×). Made full 5-fold × 260 ep feasible (~2.6 h) inside the 4 h budget where run1 managed 1 fold × 100 ep.
- Foreground constraint: training chunked via checkpoint/resume (`scripts/train.py --chunk-seconds 520`, exit 3 = resume) — 18 sequential ~9-min foreground runs.
- Fold val MAEs: 0.19432 / 0.19599 / 0.19258 / 0.18934 / 0.19583.
- Postprocess: median across 5 fold test preds (MAE-optimal aggregator; scored-region fold spread std 0.115, mean-vs-median absdiff 0.037), then snap to the 950-value training pressure grid (validated on OOF: 0.19361→0.19222).
sections.Tree search decision: **Not used — deliberately.** One evaluation node here is a full LSTM training run (~30 min/fold, ~2.6 h for an honest 5-fold CV). A ~60-node search is impossible in a 4 h budget; even a shallow search would trade the one affordable full-CV model for several unconverged ones. Skill fallback applied: single linear iteration pass (run1 baseline → run2 improved recipe). Tree search stays appropriate for cheap-eval tabular comps, not per-node-hours deep-learning comps.
sections.Artifacts:
- `submission.csv` — 603,600 rows, id order matches sample_submission.csv, median+snap.
- `scripts/train.py` — full pipeline (features→train→ensemble→submission), checkpoint/resume.
- `scripts/work/` — fold test preds, feature cache, checkpoint.
- `oof_lstm_run2.npy`, `cv_result.json`, `experiments.json` (v2 schema).
- Run1 archived under `.run1-archive/`.
sections.If more budget: Second seed per fold + median over 10 members (~+2.6 h); LSTM+GRU hybrid or deeper (5×384) model — public solutions suggest ~0.15 territory needs those plus ~300 epochs.

texts.headless_run2.log:
Done. Benchmark run complete.

**Result: 5-fold OOF masked MAE 0.19222** (snapped; raw 0.19361) — run1 got 0.24004 on one fold, grade 0.2315. Medal threshold 0.1638 likely still out of reach, but −0.048 CV improvement.

**What run2 did:**
- Same BiLSTM-4x256 seq2seq recipe as run1, +12 features (R×C cross one-hot, cummax/cummean, reverse-cumsum) = 53 per-timestep features, masked L1 on scored region only.
- Key lever was throughput, not architecture: bf16 autocast + whole dataset resident on GPU + cudnn.benchmark cut epoch time 46.8s to 6.9s (~6.8×). That turned run1's "1 fold × 100 epochs" budget into "5 folds × 260 epochs" in ~2.6h.
- Foreground-only constraint handled by checkpoint/resume chunking: 18 sequential ~9-min runs, per-epoch seeded shuffle replay, fully deterministic across restarts.
- Fold val MAEs 0.18934–0.19599. Submission = median across 5 fold models (MAE-optimal aggregator) + snap to the 950-value pressure grid (snap validated on OOF: −0.0014).
- Diagnostic worth noting: fold models disagree wildly (std 2.57) only in the unscored expiratory region; scored-region spread is 0.115.

**Tree search: skipped, documented in STATUS.md** — one eval node = ~30 min of LSTM training; a 60-node search cannot fit a 4h budget, so linear iteration (run1 baseline → run2 recipe) was the right fallback.

**Deliverables:** `submission.csv` (603,600 rows, id order verified, values in train range), `STATUS.md` 3-line summary, `experiments.json` v2 entry, new 「逐時步序列」section + snap/median notes in `knowledge/experience.md`, memory updated.

experiments.notes: run2: 53 features (run1's 41 + RxC cross one-hot + cummax/cummean/rev-cumsum), bf16 autocast, GPU-resident data, 260-epoch OneCycle, 5-fold mean ensemble; raw OOF 0.19361 / snapped 0.19222 Final submission uses MEDIAN across 5 fold models (MAE-optimal aggregator; scored-region mean-vs-median absdiff 0.037), then snap.
